description: Returns a booking by its id and token (from create_booking or its manageUrl), with `changeableUntil`, `refundableUntil`, `canCancel` and `cancelReasonRequired`. For a series, `series` lists every meeting with its own manageUrl.

id.description: a string at least 1 character(s) long
id.title: minLength(1)

token.description: a string at least 10 character(s) long
token.title: minLength(10)

name: get_booking
title: View a booking (invitee)
